purpose: Functional-validation ground-truth pairs for paper #2 §Y.4/§Y.6 expanded benchmarks. Each row has a primary citation that established the pair's epistatic relationship via wet-lab biochemistry, double-mutant genetics, or paired-NLR cosegregation. Pairs flagged 'panel_natural_variation: true' are detectable in the GraphGWAS panels (1011 Yeast Genomes / 1001 Arabidopsis Genomes / 3K Rice Genomes / 1KG); 'false' means the pair is only validated in lab strains.

human.notes: For 1KG chr21+22 specifically: only CYP2D6×CYP3A4 (chr22×chr7) is on-chromosome for chr22. Most canonical human epistasis pairs are HLA (chr6) x other-loci. Recommend simulating functional-architecture-matched epistasis (paralog pairs, enhancer×promoter) rather than insisting on real chr21+22 hits. Tier classification follows the agent's rigor scale (A = wet-lab functional + replicated).

tier_legend.A_gwas_pharmacogenetic: Population-scale GWAS-validated drug-response or disease-modifier epistasis pair (HLA-B×ERAP1, TPMT×NUDT15, VKORC1×CYP2C9, etc.)
tier_legend.B_disease_modifier: Disease-modifier pair with mechanistic evidence but limited population-scale replication.
tier_legend.A_billmann_corum_high: CORUM protein complex co-members; HAP1 GI screen + DepMap co-essentiality both confirm functional grouping (integrated AUPRC ≥ 0.5 OR both component AUPRCs ≥ 0.4).
tier_legend.B_billmann_corum_supported: CORUM protein complex co-members; HAP1 GI screen + DepMap evaluated but integrated AUPRC < 0.5.
tier_legend.C_billmann_corum_only: CORUM protein complex co-members; not in DepMap AUPRC eval set (Billmann HAP1 GI evidence only).

field_caveats.yeast: Most lab-strain pairs (Costanzo CellMap deletions) are not natural-variation-detectable in the 1011 panel; only Goldstein 2025-confirmed hub-QTL (CLN3, MKT1, GPA1, HAP1, IRA2, KRE33) are reliably segregating. Verify allele-frequency in panel before treating any pair as panel ground truth.
field_caveats.arabidopsis: Tier-1 pairs (FRI×FLC, MAM1×AOP2, RRS1×RPS4) have allelic variation in 1001G; Tier-2/3 (BRI1×BAK1, SHR×SCR) are highly conserved — useful as positive-control architecture, but expect low panel detection power.
field_caveats.rice: All Tier-A pairs have characterized variants in 3K RG (Wang 2018 Nature 557:43). For SUB1A: 3K RG is biased — SUB1A is rare outside FR13A-derived lines.
field_caveats.human: Hemani 2014 Nature trans-eQTL pairs largely retracted as haplotype artifact. Most long-range LD pair hits from eMERGE/UKBB 2023 are statistically marginal with no functional follow-up. The Tier-A pairs above are the ones that survived independent functional validation.
